canonical_project: Hypernext Data Center Limited DR campus (proposed, Rs 4,200 crore)
notes: Largest proposal (Rs 4,200 crore) at Chhattisgarh Investor Connect, Hyderabad (June 2026), described as India's first dedicated disaster-recovery datacenter campus in Chhattisgarh; ~250 jobs. District not specified in sources - attributed to Raipur (state DC hub, likely Nava Raipur) as a C-grade MoU-level lead; Hypernext (hypernxt.com) plans 1.6 GW hyperscale/DR capacity across India by 2028.
